second_order: defending and repairing snek under pressure
theme_note: These passages all mobilize, prioritize, or delimit repair when snek is described as stepped on, cut, overwritten, or threatened. What varies is the named threat (flags, logos, unidentified placers), the urgency, and whether defense is bounded by a warning not to become the aggressor.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against making agreements and helping allies; kept separate because these codes direct work on snek itself.

second_order: steering snek around other people's work
theme_note: These passages work out where a growing snek can pass without wiping out another piece. They vary between requests from neighbours, internal route choices, going behind or around, greyscaling or narrowing, and accepting small overlaps.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against drawing plans and making agreements; kept separate because the shared practice is accommodating existing artwork in the route.

theme_note: These passages make peace, seek contact, announce allies, thank cooperation, or test whether an agreement is holding. Variation includes direct neighbour exchanges, Discord agreements reported back, private messages, failed treaties, debts after mutual defense, and even an unanswered offer to coexist with the Void.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against steering routes and fighting the Void; kept separate because these codes concern the relationship and its terms, not simply the pixels to place.

theme_note: These passages propose templates, outlines, road maps, reroutes, lettering, and design adjustments. They vary between repairing recognizable form, extending the body, accepting an unplanned result, and recognizing that apparently hostile pixels were another community embellishment.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against defending snek and keeping its slogan; kept separate because these passages make or revise the visible design.

second_order: bringing people in and coordinating their work
theme_note: These passages try to turn scattered placers into organized contributors through a subreddit banner, direct outreach, Discord, priorities, handovers, and contested bot or account use. The methods vary from inviting voluntary pixels to soliciting credentials, and the record includes both using automation and removing a bot-mobilization post.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against defending and making agreements; kept separate because the common practice is assembling and coordinating contributors.

second_order: keeping 'No Step On Snek' while arguing over politics and ownership
theme_note: These passages police what the shared image and slogan should mean: retaining the original wording, resisting subreddit advertising in the slogan, debating political marks, asking about Pinochet associations, and later claiming organic ownership. What varies is whether participants protect a meme, reject or import politics, apologize and reverse a decision, or describe authenticity after the event.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against visual design; kept separate because the disagreement is over meaning, affiliation and ownership rather than pixel technique.

theme_note: These passages redirect defense beyond snek to Purple, Rainbow Road, shawnhate and smaller artworks when the Void threatens the corner. They vary between warnings, requests, reciprocal thanks, protective arguments and retrospective footage.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against defending snek and making alliances; kept separate because the practice is spending effort on allied or smaller work under a shared Void threat.

second_order: thanking, joking and recounting what snek became
theme_note: These passages sustain the group by showing, praising and joking about snek, then celebrate survival and recount the community formed around it. Variation runs from brief in-event appreciation to post-event thanks, claims of uniqueness, and replaying the Void attack.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against recruiting contributors; kept separate because these passages recognize and narrate participation rather than ask for more of it.

second_order: letting the tongue become its own group
theme_note: These passages distinguish the tongue from the body, redirect scarce effort, and point questioners to the splinter subreddit. What varies is whether separation is treated as a practical priority, an information answer, or a child that has grown up.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against defending and coordinating snek; retained as a single small theme because no other codes describe letting a part become its own group.

second_order: telling people to kill a dirty Bills logo
theme_note: This single-code theme preserves an explicit instruction to remove another logo; it belongs with none of the negotiated or bounded defense practices.
regrouped_from: Opened during the counter-reading rather than forcing the contrary item into defending or steering themes.
